name: Lee Hyeong-cheol
bio: Lee Hyeong-cheol (이형철) is a South Korean actor.

credits.title: K-POP: The Debut
credits.overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her, but when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

credits.title: No Mercy
credits.overview: A woman seeks to take revenge when her younger sister disappears and she finds out that her sister suffered violence and sexual abuse from school bullies.

credits.title: Deranged
credits.overview: People binge eat and suffer from extreme thirst, which leads them to go crazy for water. They cannot control themselves because they are brainwashed by a parasite.

credits.title: Love Phobia
credits.overview: On a sunny day, a boy named Jo-kang meets Ari, a girl in a yellow raincoat, and they become friends. Jo-kang falls helplessly in love with the quirky but attractive Ari, but one day, she suddenly disappears.

credits.title: Hi, Dharma 2: Showdown In Seoul
credits.overview: Following the last wish of an old master, three monks head to Seoul to rest his remains in the Mushim Temple. However, they discover that the heavily indebted host monk has abandoned the temple and its inhabitants. credits.title: Weekend Warriors
credits.overview: Guerilla fighters take hostage twenty Korean workers in the Philippines. The Korean army dispatches five special unit agents to carry out a rescue mission. But when a mischievous computer hacker tampers with military computer records, five soldiers are sent to wrong jungles of the Philippines.
